name: UI 连通排错锚点校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# UI 连通排错锚点校验 Capsule
# 验证 UI 连通性排错章节标题、用途与核心检查项

echo "🔍 抓取 UI 连通排错章节..."
curl -s -o ui-connect.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/troubleshooting#dashboard-control-ui-connectivity

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证章节标题..."
grep -q "Dashboard / Control UI Connectivity" ui-connect.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证防火墙检查项..."
grep -q "Firewall Rules" ui-connect.html && echo "firewall ok" || echo "firewall fail"

# 清理
rm -f ui-connect.html
description: 验证 UI 连通性排错章节标题、用途与核心检查项
